title: Run defaults proposals automatically after introspection and at drain
summary: Retry of job 20261025-033738-yz2d, which failed only for low disk (environment), not for its work. Redo the original change: run `Athena::propose` automatically after each recorded introspection and once at drain start, so pending proposals appear in `athena status` and in-limit ones go through drain's existing steward path. Audience: the maintainer reading status, and the verifier running cargo test.

defaults_applied.how: Criteria require cargo test, clippy and fmt --check to pass.
Criteria check proposals appearing without a separate command and showing in status.
Criteria check the outcome: no manual propose needed, drain works in-limit proposals.
One focused change around the existing propose function.
CHANGELOG and module docs updated for outside readers.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: The typed request 'try again' takes precedence over the earlier introspection's proposed low-disk request, so the original proposing task is redone, not the disk-handling design.
The earlier failure was environmental (1.5 GB free, 10 GB required), so the earlier accepted reading stands unchanged.
The propose logic lives in crates/athena-core/src/proposals.rs (the request named propose.rs); the producer confirms the real path.

acceptance_criteria.text: A test (cargo test) records an introspection that brings a failure class to the distinct-job threshold and then finds a pending defaults proposal, without calling `athena propose` separately.

A test (cargo test) shows a class that already has a pending or accepted proposal, or was rejected with fewer than N newer distinct jobs, gets no new proposal after another introspection or drain start.
A test (cargo test) shows the status output lists the automatically created proposal.
A drain test (cargo test) shows propose runs at drain start, and an in-limit proposal is then approved and worked under the existing steward limit while an above-limit one is listed as waiting.
A failure inside automatic proposing only prints a line and never fails the introspection or the drain; cargo test, cargo clippy and cargo fmt --check pass.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry describing automatic proposing, and the introspect and drain module docs mention it. defaults.toml, athena.toml and .github/workflows are unchanged.

out_of_scope: Low-disk cleanup or hold behavior proposed by the introspection
Changing the proposal threshold, steward limit, or defaults.toml/athena.toml
